$schema-note: Mutation PLAN for the remaining two channel runtimes. Every row names an exact anchor in a committed file, the replacement, and the command to run. `node scripts/run-win271-mutations.mjs <this file> <results>` applies one row at a time, runs the command from the repository root, restores the file, and records the exit code the run actually returned. Nothing here is a prediction.
tranche: M4.5 — packages/adapters/channel-whatsapp and packages/adapters/channel-telegram, the third and fourth ChannelRuntimes (founder decision D10: Discord, then WhatsApp, then Telegram; none dropped)
purpose: A green suite proves the code passes its own cases. Each row removes exactly one property these directories, their wiring or their configuration claims, and records whether a NAMED case turned red.

mutations.name: W01 the digest grammar accepts any length
mutations.guards: trailing garbage after a genuine digest is refused, because Buffer.from(hex) would decode the genuine bytes

mutations.name: W02 the length guard before timingSafeEqual is removed
mutations.guards: a truncated digest is FALSE and never a RangeError an anonymous caller can provoke
mutations.from:
if (expected.length !== presented.length) return false;
  return timingSafeEqual(expected, presented);

mutations.name: W03 the sha256= prefix is not required
mutations.guards: a bare digest, and a sha1= digest from the same header family, are refused

mutations.name: W04 an empty configured app secret is accepted
mutations.guards: an install that left the variable blank cannot be signed for by anybody

mutations.name: W05 the HMAC key and message are swapped
mutations.guards: the construction is HMAC(app secret, raw body) and not its transpose

mutations.name: W06 the verify token is compared by prefix
mutations.guards: a token that is a PREFIX of the configured one is refused

mutations.name: W07 the handshake accepts any hub.mode
mutations.guards: an unsubscribe GET is not a subscription handshake

mutations.name: W08 a batched delivery admits its FIRST message
mutations.guards: a delivery carrying more than one message is refused rather than half-admitted

mutations.name: W09 the thread key puts the CUSTOMER second
mutations.guards: extractPlatformChannelId returns the business line, so a channel rule names a line and not a person

mutations.name: W10 the business's own line is not ignored
mutations.guards: a delivery claiming to come FROM the business line is dropped, not turned into a turn

mutations.name: W11 a phone number id that is not a Meta id is keyed on
mutations.guards: a hostile id never becomes a conversation address

mutations.name: W12 error code 190 is classified by its HTTP status
mutations.guards: a dead token arriving as an HTTP 400 is UNAUTHORIZED, so the refresh fence fires

mutations.name: W13 a 5xx on a WRITE becomes UNAVAILABLE
mutations.guards: a write that may have landed is RECONCILE and never RETRY

mutations.name: W14 the code a dropped socket really produces counts as never connected
mutations.guards: a connection dropped AFTER the far side read the request is INDETERMINATE, judged against the code the wire produces

mutations.name: W15 a pair-scoped refusal holds the whole line
mutations.guards: one throttled recipient does not silence every other conversation on the line

mutations.name: W16 a refusal does not hold its scope at all
mutations.guards: the next call inside a live window is refused HERE, with no socket opened
mutations.from:
if (scope !== null) transport.limits.hold(call.route, scope, wait);
      return err(classifyWhatsAppStatus(response.status, metaCode, call.operation, wait));

mutations.name: W17 a later smaller refusal shortens a live wait
mutations.guards: a wait the far side already imposed is never shortened

mutations.name: W18 an edit is honoured by posting a new message
mutations.guards: the Cloud API has no edit route, so an edit is REFUSED rather than turned into a second message

mutations.name: W19 a Graph error under HTTP 200 is read as a success
mutations.guards: a 200 carrying error.code is the refusal it is, never a delivered message

mutations.name: W20 link previews are turned on
mutations.guards: a URL the model echoed back is not FETCHED and rendered on the business's authority

mutations.name: W21 describePrincipal opens a socket
mutations.guards: Meta publishes no route that reads a customer profile, so the honest answer needs no request

mutations.name: W22 the text length limit is not enforced
mutations.guards: a turn whose answer is long is refused HERE rather than lost to a vendor 400

mutations.name: W23 the verify token is optional beside the app secret
mutations.guards: an install that set the app secret and no verify token cannot boot green

mutations.name: W24 the whatsapp adapter is never constructed
mutations.guards: a declared channels.whatsapp group produces the directory ADR M0.3 section 4 assigns it

mutations.name: T06 message_thread_id alone makes a topic
mutations.guards: a reply chain in a group with topics off stays the main conversation

mutations.name: T07 a topic is keyed on ITSELF, not under its chat
mutations.guards: a channel rule naming the supergroup still matches inside every topic

mutations.name: T08 the MESSAGE id becomes the admission key
mutations.guards: Telegram repeats an update_id until the endpoint answers 2xx, so that is what a redelivery collapses on

mutations.name: T09 a message from another bot is admitted
mutations.guards: two bots in one group are an unbounded loop at a model call per turn

mutations.guards: a rounded id keys the conversation on a chat that is not the one that wrote

mutations.name: T11 a chat id may not be negative
mutations.guards: every group and supergroup Telegram has is a negative id

mutations.name: T12 the route drops its ./ prefix
mutations.guards: bot<id>:<secret> puts a COLON in the first path segment, which new URL parses as a scheme

mutations.name: T13 the bot token's shape is not checked
mutations.guards: the token becomes a URL path segment, so a / in it addresses somewhere else

mutations.name: T14 the wait is read from Retry-After only
mutations.guards: Telegram puts retry_after in the BODY, and a client reading a header finds nothing
mutations.from:

  if (fromBody !== null) return Math.max(1, fromBody);

mutations.name: T15 the HTTP status outranks the envelope
mutations.guards: when a proxy has rewritten one of the two, the body is the one Telegram wrote

mutations.name: T16 a 429 does not hold its route
mutations.guards: the next call inside a live window is refused HERE, with no socket opened

mutations.name: T17 a 403 is a dead credential
mutations.guards: one person blocking the bot must not send the refresh fence to re-authorize it

mutations.name: T18 a 5xx on a WRITE becomes UNAVAILABLE
mutations.guards: a write that may have landed is RECONCILE and never RETRY

mutations.name: T19 the reason carries Telegram's description
mutations.guards: the description echoes request content back and is never put in something that is logged

mutations.guards: editMessageText has no such parameter; the message already knows where it is

mutations.name: T21 a topic reply is sent to the TOPIC id
mutations.guards: a Telegram topic is not a chat, so sending to it addresses a chat that does not exist

mutations.name: T22 the text length limit is not enforced
mutations.guards: a turn whose answer is long is refused HERE rather than lost to a vendor 400

mutations.name: T23 a later smaller refusal shortens a live wait
mutations.guards: a wait the far side already imposed is never shortened

mutations.name: T24 the telegram adapter is never constructed
mutations.guards: a declared channels.telegram group produces the directory ADR M0.3 section 4 assigns it

mutations.name: T25 the secret token's alphabet is not configured
mutations.guards: an install cannot set a token setWebhook would refuse, or one short enough to guess online

mutations.name: W14b ECONNRESET joins the never-connected set
mutations.guards: nothing — RECORDED AS AN EQUIVALENT MUTANT. `fetch` on this runtime reports UND_ERR_SOCKET for a socket dropped after the request was read, never ECONNRESET, so no case in this suite can observe ECONNRESET's membership. W14 is the row that guards the code which actually arrives.

mutations.name: W25 the documented text limit is widened
mutations.guards: the 4096-character limit is META'S figure and not this repository's, so a behavioural case that reads the constant cannot be widened with it

mutations.name: T01b the digest is removed but the length guard stays
mutations.guards: nothing a functional case can observe — RECORDED AS AN EQUIVALENT MUTANT. With the guard in place a length mismatch is still FALSE and still not a throw. What the digest buys is that the comparison is constant-time in the token's LENGTH as well as its bytes: without it the guard returns early for a wrong-length token and an attacker learns the length by timing. No behavioural case can see that, and the digest is kept rather than deleted because the property is real.
mutations.from:
const expected = digest(configured);
  const offered = digest(presented);
mutations.to:
const expected = Buffer.from(configured, "utf8");
  const offered = Buffer.from(presented, "utf8");
